title: Seoul, Basel explore partnership for 2027 architecture biennale in Seoul
caption:
Seoul officials and architects met in Basel to exchange concepts on shared housing and open-access art storage. The collaboration feeds into the 2027 Seoul Biennale and the planned Seoripul museum opening in 2028.

Source: Koreaherald - Seoul, Basel explore partnership for 2027 architecture biennale in Seoul
